verdict.rationale: RUN documents some of its own export paths. Payroll and HR reports can be viewed, customized and printed online, and journal entries can be exported to QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file. API Central is a developer building block for data access, not a bulk export feature, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or all-data export, named open formats (CSV/JSON) covering employee, payroll and tax history, an offboarding or leave-the-platform process, and independent corroboration that complete data portability works.
